titlepage-footer: "Template v0.1.0, 2026-10-27"

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: setup
#| cache: false

noacsr::source_all_functions()
attach(global_variables())

# Version of the statistical analysis plan (SAP) that governs this report.
sap.variables <- yaml::read_yaml("_variables.yml")

# Report metadata filled when a report is prepared for a meeting. This first
# report covers data from the first batch only, because only Batch 1 data
# collection has been completed at the data cut-off date. Update these values
# (and the data-feeding chunks) when later batches complete.
report.number <- 1 # report number (1 to number_to_text(batches))
batch.covered <- 1 # batch whose data collection has just completed
data.cutoff.date <- "<date>" # end of data collection for the batch
report.version <- "0.1.0 (template)"
report.date <- "2026-10-27"

# gtsummary otherwise prints with gt. Its autofit step sizes each column to
# the full label, which is wider than the page and clips the first column.
# Scale those widths so the table fits and the text wraps (same as the SAP).
if (!isTRUE(knitr::is_latex_output()) && requireNamespace("flextable", quietly = TRUE)) {
  flextable::set_flextable_defaults(
    font.family = "EB Garamond",
    font.size = 8,
    theme_fun = flextable::theme_booktabs
  )
  if (isTRUE(knitr::pandoc_to("docx")) && requireNamespace("gtsummary", quietly = TRUE)) {
    fit_word_table <- function(x, max.width = 5.5) {
      widths <- x$body$colwidths
      total <- sum(widths)
      if (!is.finite(total) || total <= max.width) {
        return(x)
      }
      flextable::width(x, width = as.numeric(widths) * max.width / total)
    }
    gtsummary::set_gtsummary_theme(list(
      `pkgwide-str:print_engine` = "flextable",
      `as_flex_table-lst:addl_cmds` = list(
        valign = rlang::expr(fit_word_table())
      )
    ))
  }
}

# Pooled summaries of the primary and secondary outcomes, the data dictionary
# reading helper, and the prepared-data table renderer all live in the shared
# function library (functions/sdmc_report_prepared_data.R). Table chunks below
# read their values from the prepared CSVs in sdmc-report/prepared/
# (see sdmc-report/README.md); absent or blank CSVs render blank shells.

# Reference table of the outcomes assessed in the trial, for the appendix.
render_outcomes_summary_table <- function() {
  outcomes.table <- jsonlite::fromJSON("tables/outcomes-summary.json")
  outcomes.table <- outcomes.table[
    c("outcome", "design_component", "data_type", "population", "effect_measure")
  ]
  names(outcomes.table) <- c(
    "Outcome",
    "Design component",
    "Data type",
    "Population",
    "Effect measure"
  )
  if (isTRUE(knitr::is_latex_output())) {
    knitr::kable(outcomes.table, format = "latex", booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE) |>
      kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("repeat_header"), font_size = 8)
  } else if (requireNamespace("flextable", quietly = TRUE)) {
    flextable::flextable(outcomes.table) |>
      flextable::font(fontname = "EB Garamond", part = "all") |>
      flextable::fontsize(size = 8, part = "all") |>
      flextable::theme_booktabs()
  } else {
    knitr::kable(outcomes.table)
  }
}
```

{{< pagebreak >}}

# Purpose of this report

The joint Trial Steering and Data Monitoring Committee (SDMC) meets after each batch has completed the trial. For each meeting, the Trial Team prepares this report and the Trial Management Group approves it before circulation. The report prepared after half of the batches have completed the trial is the interim analysis report.

The purposes of reviewing these reports are to:

-   assess the trial's feasibility and recommend that the trial be stopped if it is not feasible, for example if hospitals fail to adhere to the randomisation schedule or if there are substantial missing data in outcomes; and
-   compare characteristics across intervention conditions to monitor for differential recruitment or ascertainment between the intervention and control groups.

No efficacy stopping is planned, because any estimates obtained at the time of the interim analysis would be associated with major statistical uncertainties.

<!-- Text from SAP section Interim analysis (statistical-analysis-plan.qmd,
@sec-interim-analysis) and the shared interim-analysis include. -->

**Note on outcome values.** As specified in the SAP, this report does not present or compare outcome values by intervention condition, to avoid biasing the SDMC or the Trial Management Group. Outcome summaries are therefore pooled across intervention conditions and periods.

## How to read this report

Conventions follow the SAP. In every descriptive table we summarise discrete variables as frequencies and percentages, and continuous and count variables as medians and interquartile ranges (Q1–Q3). We report missing values for each variable, and we do not adjust any of these summaries for clustering.

{{< pagebreak >}}

# Trial progress

Trial progress is reported overall, by batch, and by intervention condition. Counts cover the number of clusters included and dropping out, and the number of potentially eligible patients screened, patients included, patients who did not consent to out-of-hospital follow-up, and patients lost to follow-up.

This first report covers data from the first batch only, because only Batch 1 data collection was complete at the data cut-off date. The same tables and figures will cover subsequent batches as their data collection completes.

## Trial roll-out

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-trial-rollout
#| fig.cap: "Trial roll-out figure for Batch 1. Light grey bars show the planned patient-inclusion periods. Coloured bars show the observed standard-care, transition, and intervention periods. A diamond on a cluster's bar marks each ATLS^®^ training course, and a cluster may have more than one course. Placeholder dates will be replaced with observed dates."
#| fig.align: "center"
#| fig-pos: H
#| out-width: "100%"
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
rollout <- utils::read.csv(
  "tables/cluster-rollout.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)
training <- utils::read.csv(
  "tables/cluster-training.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)
# This first report covers Batch 1 only; later reports will pass the full
# prepared rollout and training data for all completed batches.
rollout <- rollout[rollout$batch == batch.covered, , drop = FALSE]
training <- training[training$cluster %in% rollout$cluster, , drop = FALSE]
knitr::include_graphics(
  create_trial_rollout_flowchart(
    data = rollout,
    training = training,
    return.figure = FALSE,
    device = "png"
  )
)
```

## Participant flow (CONSORT flowcharts)

The flowcharts below summarise participant flow, following the CONSORT-style diagrams specified in the SAP. Counts are left as blank `(n=)` placeholders and will be completed with observed counts; no simulated counts are shown. For this first report, completed counts will cover Batch 1 only.

<!-- When counts are available, pass them through the `counts` argument of the
create_*_consort_diagram() functions (see the README in sdmc-report/). Figures
are written under sdmc-report/figures/ so the SAP's own CONSORT files are not
overwritten. -->

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| label: fig-consort-clusters
#| fig.cap: "Cluster-level CONSORT flowchart with blank counts. Boxes cover clusters assessed and randomised, losses and exclusions after randomisation with reasons, and clusters included in the primary analysis, by sequence and overall. Counts are to be completed with observed data; for this first report they will cover Batch 1 only."
#| fig.align: "center"
#| fig-pos: H
#| out-width: "100%"
#| message: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
if (!dir.exists("sdmc-report/figures")) {
  dir.create("sdmc-report/figures", recursive = TRUE)
}
knitr::include_graphics(
  create_cluster_consort_diagram(
    sequences = sequences,
    batches = batches,
    total.months = total.months,
    min.standard.care.months = min.standard.care.months,
    transition.months = transition.months,
    return.figure = FALSE,
    device = "png",
    use.simulated.data = FALSE,
    file.name = "sdmc-report/figures/consort-clusters.png"
  )
)
```
